title: Changes in Resting Metabolic Rate Following Orthopedic Surgery
official: Changes in Resting Metabolic Rate Following Orthopedic Surgery
summary: This project is intended to determine the magnitude and duration of RMR changes in patients receiving orthopedic surgery. The result will help to guide postoperative nutrition recommendations in patients receiving orthopedic surgery.

interventions.name: Pre-surgical nutrition, hydration, RMR, and body composition assessments
Post-surgical nutrition, hydration, RMR and body composition assessments

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any individual over 15 undergoing an orthopedic surgery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant female
* \< 15 years old
